llm_request: Draft a professional English email to Koushik confirming the rescheduled training time of 10:00 AM-11:00 (Beijing Time) and 8:00 AM (Dhaka Time), acknowledging the previous scheduling challenge, and requesting confirmation of availability. Include a subject line and proper closing.
llm_response:
Subject: Confirmation: Rescheduled Training Time

Dear Koushik,

Following up on our previous scheduling challenge, I am writing to confirm the newly rescheduled time for our upcoming training session. 

The training will now take place from **10:00 AM to 11:00 AM (Beijing Time)**, which corresponds to **8:00 AM (Dhaka Time)**. 

Could you please confirm your availability for this updated time slot? 

Thank you for your flexibility and understanding as we worked to get this coordinated. I look forward to our session.

Best regards,

[Your Name]  
[Your Title/Position]  
[Your Company]
